battle.name: 北宋統一戰爭
battle.brief: 陳橋兵變後趙匡胤建宋，依「先南後北」之序削平荊南、南唐、後蜀、南漢、吳越、漳泉與北漢，至太平興國四年混一中原。戰役以步軍刀盾結陣為骨幹，刀盾手盾緣相扣抵禦騎軍衝鋒；卡面羅馬方陣盾所代表的盾牆傳統，在宋代以柳葉盾、團牌的形式落地，北伐契丹更以拒馬與弩陣硬撼高梁河鐵騎。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 北宋統一戰爭係唐末五代割據局面嘅收尾，自 960 年正月陳橋兵變起，至 979 年冬平北漢止。交戰一方係新立嘅北宋，另一方係五代十國末期仍據一方土地嘅割據政權：受禪之前嘅後周（960 年二月趙匡胤受七歲嘅周恭帝禪位，建立宋朝）、荊南高氏（963 年高瑋納土）、南唐李氏（963 年曹彬破金陵，李煜奉表請罪）、後蜀孟氏（965 年孟昶出降）、南漢劉氏（966 年曹彬用兵嶺南，971 年劉鋐出降）、吳越錢氏（978 年錢俶納土）、漳泉清源軍陳氏（978 年陳洪進納土），以及北漢劉氏（979 年太原城破，北漢主降）。北漢一役中遼朝契丹出兵援助，契丹蕭綽與耶律沙、耶律休哥等部將率精騎南下，太原城下數度交鋒，宋軍靠攻城器具與援軍頂住契丹騎兵。指揮系統方面，北宋以中書省掌政、樞密院掌軍，三衙（殿前司、侍衛馬軍司、侍衛步軍司）分領禁軍，趙匡胤以杯酒釋兵權收回宿將兵權，戰事多由樞密使趙普、曹彬、潘美、曹翰分統，節度使只管民政，調兵之權歸於中央；割據一方則多由節度使兼領民政，兵權、財權、治權合一，故能憑一州一鎮與中央周旋數十年，蘇、鄂、湘、蜀一帶的地方軍甚至自徵自募，形成中央禁軍與地方鎮軍兩套武力並存的局面。
countriesEn: The Northern Song unification war was the closing phase of the division left by the late Tang and the Five Dynasties, running from the Chenqiao mutiny in the first month of 960 to the reduction of Northern Han in the last months of 979. One side was the newly founded Song; the other was the collection of regional states that still held ground in the late Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms: the Later Zhou, from which Zhao Kuangyin received the abdication of the seven-year-old Zhou Gong in the second month of 960 and founded the Song; Jingnan of the Gao clan, whose ruler Gao Wei surrendered in 963; Southern Tang of the Li clan, whose capital Jinling was taken by Cao Bin in 963 and whose ruler Li Yu filed a submission of surrender; Later Shu of the Meng clan, whose Meng Chang came out to surrender in 965; Southern Han of the Liu clan, which Cao Bin opened up from 966 and which ended when Liu Chang surrendered in 971; Wuyue of the Qian clan, whose Qian Chu gave up his lands in 978; Zhangquan of the Qingyuan army under the Chen clan, whose Chen Hongjin followed in 978; and Northern Han of the Liu line, whose capital Taiyuan was stormed in 979 and whose ruler surrendered. During the Northern Han campaign the Khitan Liao sent aid: the empress dowager Xiao, with Yelu Sha and Yelu Xiu among her commanders, brought cavalry south and fought repeatedly around Taiyuan, and the Song held the city only by means of siege works and reinforcing columns. On the Song side the civil administration sat in the Central Secretariat and military affairs in the Military Affairs Commission, while the three divisions of the imperial guard (Palace Guard, Cavalry Guard and Infantry Guard) commanded the army; Zhao Kuangyin took the command of the senior generals away through the cup of wine that released the military power, and campaigns were entrusted to men such as Zhao Pu, Cao Bin, Pan Mei and Cao Han, while the circuit governors were left with civil administration only and the power to move troops returned to the centre. The regional states, by contrast, combined military and civil authority in the hands of a single jiedushi, which gave them both the troops and the revenue to bargain with the centre for decades; in areas such as Su, E, Xiang and Shu the local armies even recruited and paid themselves, so that two armed systems stood side by side, the central imperial guard and the armies of the circuits.
people: 核心人物係趙匡胤與趙普。趙匡胤原為後周殿前都點檢，握禁軍於手，960 年正月率軍北上禦遼，軍至陳橋驛被部下披黃袍推戴，二月受周恭帝禪位，建立宋朝；他即位後以杯酒釋兵權收回石守信等宿將的兵權，又定下「先南後北」之大略，削平諸國之次序多出謀主趙普之口。趙普力主收精兵、削藩鎮、罷除地方武力，認為先取荊南與江南、再圖兩川嶺南、最後方窺契丹，最為穩妥。將帥方面，曹彬自請為前鋒、請緩進兵之期以明無異志，統兵平江南與南漢，卒成全功；潘美佐曹彬經略江北、進軍金陵，號令嚴明而與士卒同勞；曹翰自將攻拔潤州、揚州，斷南唐援軍之道；呂余靖、張浦等經略荊湖、湘南；楊業從軍攻北漢有功，卻屢遭削奪兵權，雍熙北伐中屯守陳家谷，遭契丹伏兵被擒，絕食三日而死。敵方主腦包括南唐李煜、其弟李從善，後蜀孟昶，南漢劉鋐，北漢劉崇、劉𪸮，吳越錢俶，漳泉陳洪進；遼方則是蕭綽與耶律休哥、耶律沙。宋太宗趙光義在位時兩度北伐皆敗，北宋自此再無主動收復燕雲之機，收復故土只能寄望於日後的守禦與歲歲進奉之盟。
peopleEn: The central figures were Zhao Kuangyin and his adviser Zhao Pu. Zhao Kuangyin was formerly commander of the palace guard of the Later Zhou and held the imperial army in his hands; in the first month of 960 he marched north against the Liao, and at the Chenqiao post station his own men draped a yellow robe over him and acclaimed him emperor, and in the second month he took the abdication of Zhou Gong and founded the Song. Once on the throne he took the command of the senior generals away through the cup of wine that released the military power, removing the commands held by men such as Shi Shouxin, and he set the broad strategy of the south first and the north afterwards, with the order of the campaigns laid down largely by his adviser Zhao Pu. Zhao Pu pressed for concentrating the army, reducing the circuits and abolishing local military power, and held that Jingnan and the Jiangnan were to be taken first, then Shu and Lingnan, and only afterwards the Liao. Among the generals Cao Bin volunteered for the vanguard and asked for a delayed timetable to prove that he bore no rebellious intent, and he led the campaigns against Southern Tang and Southern Han to complete success; Pan Mei assisted Cao Bin in the Jiangbei operations and marched on Jinling, strict in orders yet sharing the toil of his men; Cao Han took Rui and Yang with his own command and cut the road by which relief could reach Southern Tang; Lü Yujing and Zhang Pu handled Jinghu and Xiangnan; and Yang Ye, who had credit in the taking of Northern Han, was repeatedly stripped of his command, and in the Yongxi northern expedition, while covering the withdrawal at Chenjiagu, was ambushed by Khitan horse, taken prisoner and died after three days of refusing food. The enemy leaders included Li Yu of Southern Tang and his brother Li Congshan, Meng Chang of Later Shu, Liu Chang of Southern Han, Liu Chong and Liu Jun of Northern Han, Qian Chu of Wuyue and Chen Hongjin of Zhangquan; on the Liao side were the empress dowager Xiao, Yelu Xiu and Yelu Sha. Under Emperor Taizong Zhao Guangyi the two northern expeditions both failed, and from then on the Song had no opportunity left to recover the Sixteen Prefectures by its own hand; the recovery of lost ground could only be left to defence and to the settlements of later years.
kits: 卡面兵器係羅馬方陣盾（Scutum）：凸面長方，羅馬步兵列陣時盾緣彼此咬合，靠整列互相遮蔽抵擋衝擊，而非靠盾板厚重。羅馬帝國前期以後此式已漸廢，962 年之後嘅戰場上並無實物羅馬方陣盾，但同一原理在宋代以另一種面貌落地：宋軍步軍用團牌（圓形漆木，髹繪圖像）、柳葉盾（長方形、兩端圓弧、中脊隆起、蒙韋以蔽箭石）同藤牌，盾牌仍以結陣互相遮蔽為主，左手執盾、右手執刀，與長槍手、弓弩手相配，構成步兵作戰之骨幹。步軍兵器以步刀、長槍與弓弩為主，長槍手列於陣前，刀盾手居中，弓弩手壓陣而射；攻城則用雲梯、撞竿、搭火、砲石車與拒馬槊，拒馬橫列以阻騎兵衝陣；水軍有蒙衝、走舸之屬，並以火矢與火攻焚毀城門、樓櫓與船隻。遼軍精騎強調人馬俱甲，披膊、臂韝、兜鍪齊備，機動與衝撞能力遠勝宋騎；宋軍缺馬，戰馬多購自沿邊市馬與蕃部，騎兵比例偏低，只能以弩陣、拒馬、壕塹與堡寨結界抵禦。攻城時宋軍在金陵城北石牌口築木城與城牆等高以蔽箭石，成為防禦方盾牆之對稱物：進攻者造牆、據城、拼死命前進，守禦者倚牆、擲石、層層防禦，兩者同以「把軀體從飛矢中遮蔽」為共同原理。運糧則賴水路由江淮轉輸荊湖、兩川，以及關中、陝南的陸路車隊，舟車並用。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scutum: a convex rectangle whose edges were locked to the edges of neighbouring shields, so that a whole line covered one another and resisted a charge by mutual protection rather than by the thickness of the boards. The type fell out of use after the early Roman period, and no actual Roman scutum stood on a battlefield after 962, but the same principle returned to life in the Song in another form: the Song infantry used round shields of lacquered wood painted with figures, willow-leaf shields that were long rectangles with rounded ends, a raised central rib and hide covering to keep off arrows and stones, and shields woven from rattan; the shield was still used mainly by standing in a mass and shading one another, held in the left hand with a sabre in the right, and paired with spearmen and crossbowmen as the core of the foot soldier. The infantry weapons were the foot sabre, the long spear and the bow and crossbow, with spearmen in front, shield-and-sabre men in the middle and crossbowmen pressing the line with their shooting; for sieges the Song used scaling ladders, battering poles, fire-ladders, stone-throwing carts and caltrops, the caltrops set in rows to stop cavalry from breaking the line; on the water they had ram-prows and light fast boats, and used fire arrows and fire to burn gates, towers and boats. Liao heavy horse was armoured man and mount alike, with shoulder guards, vambraces and helmets, and its mobility and shock were far beyond that of Song cavalry; the Song lacked horses, buying most of them in the border markets and from the tribal peoples, so the proportion of mounted men stayed low and defence had to rest on crossbow formations, caltrops, ditches and blockhouses. In the attack on Jinling the Song built a wooden wall at Shipaikou north of the city, as high as the ramparts, to shelter the troops from arrows and stones; this was the exact counterpart of the defending shield wall, for the attacker built a wall and pushed forward, while the defender leaned on its rampart and threw stones, and both served the same principle of hiding the body from flying missiles. Grain moved by water from the Jianghuai to Jinghu and Shu, and by wagon from Guanzhong and southern Shaoxi, boats and carts together.
tactics: 宋軍作戰樣式可歸為三種。其一是野戰對騎：步軍居中結成厚陣，長槍手最前、刀盾手次之、弓弩手壓後，陣前擺拒馬，兩翼置馬軍；遇契丹精騎衝鋒時並不逐騎格鬥，而以弩矢、拒馬與結陣消耗其衝勢，待敵騎力竭而己方陣腳不亂時，再以陷陣將士反擊爭功。曹彬用兵江南時曾於池州故示怯懦、停兵十餘日，待對手驕懈方進兵，渡江則以浮橋濟軍，連下銅陵、蕪湖，直趨金陵。其二是攻堅：先以砲石、弓弩覆蓋城頭與堞口，再填壕、平壘、架雲梯，最後盾兵護梯蟻附登城；有地道可掘者別開一路，兩面夾攻。金陵一役守軍以木砲擲石，宋軍築木城蔽之，死者以萬計而木城不破，遂改塹壕圍城，斷其樵汲與援道，逼迫城內出降。其三是守禦：倚高牆、深壕、砲石與守禦器械，把進攻者的雲梯、盾牆與填壕之土同時消耗；蜀道山徑狹窄，宋軍分進合擊，糧道倚長江與棧道維持。北伐遼時宋軍一度取守勢，以堡寨、拒馬與河防抵禦遊騎，另遣一軍深入幽雲，結果糧援不繼而全軍潰散，證明遠征須以河防為基地，不可深入而無援。
tacticsEn: Song methods of war fall into three kinds. The first is the field action against cavalry: the infantry held the centre in a deep formation, spearmen in front, shield-and-sabre men next, crossbowmen pressing from behind, caltrops set before the line and the horse on both wings; when Liao heavy cavalry charged, they did not meet horse with hand but spent the enemy's strength with crossbow bolts, caltrops and the formation itself, and only when the enemy's horses were spent and their own line had not moved did the assault troops charge back to win the credit. When Cao Bin campaigned in Jiangnan he deliberately showed timidity before Chizhou and stood still for more than ten days, waiting for the enemy to grow careless before he advanced; he crossed the river on a floating bridge, took Tongling and Wuhu in succession and drove straight on Jinling. The second is the siege: first stone-throwing carts, bows and crossbows swept the ramparts and the crenellated parapets, then the ditch was filled, the glacis levelled and scaling ladders set up, and at last shield men covered the ladders while the army climbed like ants; where a tunnel could be driven, a second path was opened to strike from two sides. At Jinling the defenders answered with wooden bombards throwing stones, and the Song built its wooden wall to shelter from them, losing men by the tens of thousands without breaking through, so it fell back on trenches to besiege the city, cut its firewood and water and the road of relief, and forced the city to surrender. The third is the defence: leaning on high walls, deep ditches, stone-throwing engines and defensive works, so that the ladders, the shield wall and the earth the attackers carried in were all consumed together. In Shu the mountain tracks are narrow, so the Song army advanced by separate columns and joined up, keeping its supply line on the Yangtze and the plank roads. In the wars against the Liao the Song once took a defensive posture, blocking the raiding horse with blockhouses, caltrops and the river defences, while sending another column deep into You and Yun; but the grain and the reinforcements failed to keep up, the whole army scattered, and the lesson was written on the field that a distant expedition must rest on the river defences and never advance without support.
data: 時間與範圍：戰爭自 960 年正月陳橋兵變起，至 979 年冬平北漢止，前後約二十年，其間後周、荊南、南唐、後蜀、南漢、吳越、漳泉、北漢共八個政權移交或覆滅。節奏可見於數個時點：曹彬統兵平江南自 963 年正月出師至年末克金陵，歷時不足一年；平後蜀自陝鳳出兵至孟昶出降，歷時數十日；南漢自 966 年用兵到 971 年劉鋐出降，前後約五年；吳越與漳泉同於 978 年納土；北漢自 979 年春大舉至十一月城破，前後約十個月。兵制上，削冗之後禁軍兵籍仍以數十萬計，廂兵、蕃兵另計，可用之卒遠少於此數；宋廷缺馬，戰馬多購自沿邊市馬與蕃部，騎兵比例偏低，每役仍以步卒結陣為主。裝備上，一次攻城消耗最巨者為箭矢，城下久攻之日費以萬計；金陵木城一役宋軍死者以萬計，木城終不能破。人口與疆域：太平興國五年（980）北宋版籍人口約三千二百五十萬；北界止於海河、霸州與雁門關一線，燕雲十六州仍在遼手，西北河西在夏人手中。戰損方面，979 年高梁河一役宋軍大潰，太宗僅以身免，乘驢車退保涿州；986 年雍熙北伐三路皆敗，中路曹彬敗於幽州城下，西路潘美、楊業敗於朔州、陳家谷與君子館，楊業陣亡於陳家谷口，此後宋人不再有深入燕雲之大軍。
dataEn: Time and scope: the war ran from the Chenqiao mutiny in the first month of 960 to the reduction of Northern Han in the last months of 979, about twenty years, during which eight regimes changed hands or fell, namely the Later Zhou, Jingnan, Southern Tang, Later Shu, Southern Han, Wuyue, Zhangquan and Northern Han. The rhythm shows in several dated points: Cao Bin opened the campaign against the Jiangnan in the first month of 963 and took Jinling before the end of that year, a matter of less than a year; the campaign against Later Shu ran from the departure out of Shaofeng to the surrender of Meng Chang over a few dozen days; Southern Han was opened up in 966 and ended with the surrender of Liu Chang in 971, about five years in all; Wuyue and Zhangquan both handed over their territory in 978; and Northern Han was besieged from the great effort of 979 until the city fell in the eleventh month, about ten months in all. On the military side, the register of the imperial guard still counted tens of thousands of men after the cutbacks, with the provincial and tribal troops listed apart, and the men actually fit for service were far fewer; the Song lacked horses, buying most of them in the border markets and from the tribes, so the share of cavalry stayed low and every campaign still turned on infantry drawn up in formation. On the equipment side, arrows were consumed fastest of all, and a siege held against the walls could spend tens of thousands in a day; at the wooden wall before Jinling the Song lost men by the tens of thousands and the wall still did not break through. Population and territory: in the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo (980) the registered population of the Northern Song was about thirty-two and a half million; the northern frontier ran along the Hai river, Bazhou and the Yanmen pass, with the Sixteen Prefectures still in Liao hands and the Hexi corridor in the hands of the Tangut. On losses: at Gaolianghe in 979 the Song army was utterly routed, the emperor escaped with nothing but his life and took refuge at Zhuozhou in a donkey cart; and in the Yongxi expedition of 986 all three columns failed, Cao Bin being beaten before Youzhou in the middle route, while in the western route Pan Mei and Yang Ye were beaten at Shuozhou, Chenjiagu and Junziguan, Yang Ye falling at Chenjiagu, after which the Song sent no more great army into the Sixteen Prefectures.
cause: 起事有遠因亦有近因。遠因是唐末以來藩鎮割據、賦稅兵權下移，五代六十餘年更替頻仍，「一縣之地數主、一州之兵各有所屬」，募兵而成的護鎮兵與中央禁軍長期對峙，農軍散而復聚，戰亂循環。後周世宗整軍、括田、整飭貨幣，先後削平兩蜀、南唐與荊南，統一的呼聲早已高漲，趙匡胤以禁軍統帥之位握有實力，軍隊於是成為其資本。近因是959年後周世宗病逝、七歲的恭帝嗣位，禁軍領兵之權落在趙匡胤手中；960年正月他奉命北上禦遼，軍至陳橋驛，部下兵變推戴，他回京逼恭帝禪位，宋代周而立。制度上，中央直屬的統一軍隊必須先消滅那些自徵自募、據州縣而自治的割據軍隊；而要消滅它們又需要一支強大的中央禁軍，於是削平諸國成為鞏固新朝與解除藩鎮隱患的必由之路。趙普與宋廷議定的「先南後北」次序，正是考量到宋軍缺馬、缺水師、缺遠征後勤而作出的取捨：江南、兩川、嶺南有水陸可運、城堡可攻，而燕雲地廣、人稀、城堅，遠征無援。
causeEn: The outbreak had both distant and immediate causes. The distant cause was the fragmentation of the late Tang, with revenue and military power slipping down to the circuits, and sixty-odd years of rapid dynastic turnover, so that a single county might have several masters and the soldiers of a single prefecture belonged to someone else; the recruited guard armies of the circuits and the central imperial guard confronted one another for a long time, and the peasant troops dispersed and re-formed, and the cycle of war went on. The Later Zhou under Shizong reformed the army, surveyed the fields and reformed the currency, and had already cut down Shu, Southern Tang and Jingnan, and the cry for unity was already loud; Zhao Kuangyin held real power as commander of the imperial guard, and the army became his capital. The immediate cause was that in 959 Shizong of the Later Zhou died of illness and the seven-year-old Gongdi succeeded him, and the command of the guard fell into the hands of Zhao Kuangyin; in the first month of 960 he was sent north against the Liao, and at the Chenqiao station his troops mutinied and acclaimed him, and he returned to the capital, forced Gongdi to abdicate and founded the Song in place of the Zhou. Institutionally, a unified army directly answerable to the centre had first to destroy the self-recruited, self-governing regional armies that held prefectures and counties by their own right; and to destroy them required a strong central imperial guard, so that reducing the regional states was the unavoidable road to consolidating the new dynasty and to removing the standing danger of the circuits. The order of south first, north afterwards settled by Zhao Pu and the court took due account of the Song's shortage of horses, of naval force and of the logistics of distant campaigns: Jiangnan, Shu and Lingnan could be supplied by water and by land and taken by assault, whereas You and Yun were vast, sparsely populated and walled, and a distant expedition there had no support.
impact: 影響分國際與國內兩面。國際上，唐末五代以來近一個世紀的分裂局面結束，中原、江南、蜀地、嶺南與河東重新歸於一個朝代，後世視之為統一的開端；宋也從此承擔了統一後的邊防壓力：北有契丹據燕雲十六州與河北平州，西有黨項建立的夏，西南有大理與交趾，中原政權只守得住既有邊界。兩次北伐失利後，宋對遼由攻轉守，形成沿邊界線的長期對峙，1004年澶淵之盟是這條線的標志。國內上，宋室以收精兵、削藩鎮、文官治軍、重文抑武立國，禁軍規模與集中度同時上升，而冗官冗費累積，戰鬥力與財力不相稱，埋下積貧積弱的隱患；同時統一後的南方經濟得以保持完整，農業、手工業與城鎮恢復，漕運與商稅成為國用主要來源，後來紙幣與全國性市場的形成都以這次統一為前提。歷史上，這場戰爭還改變了兵與官的關係：地方軍隊被取消，軍權集中於京師，國策由「守土」轉為「守邊」，中國此後數百年的邊防格局與和平狀態，都從這一時期的安排裡生長出來。
impactEn: The consequences fall into an external and an internal side. Externally, nearly a century of division since the late Tang and the Five Dynasties came to an end, and the central plain, the Jiangnan, Shu, Lingnan and the Hedong came once more under a single dynasty, which later ages treat as the beginning of unification; but the Song now carried the burden of frontier defence on a unified territory: the Khitan held the Sixteen Prefectures and Pingzhou in the north, the Tangut state of Xia stood in the west, Dali and Jiaoji in the south-west, and the central government could only hold the borders it had. After two failed northern expeditions the Song turned from attack to defence against the Liao, and a long confrontation along the frontier line followed, marked in 1004 by the Chanyuan treaty. Internally, the Song founded itself on concentrating the army, reducing the circuits, putting the army under civil officials and holding that the civil must outweigh the military; the size and concentration of the imperial guard both rose, while redundant offices and redundant spending piled up, and military strength did not match financial strength, laying the ground for the hidden weakness of poverty and weakness. At the same time the southern economy survived unification intact, agriculture, handicrafts and towns recovered, and grain transport and commercial taxes became the main sources of state revenue; the paper money and the national market of later times both presupposed this unification. In historical terms the war also changed the relation between arms and office: the regional armies were abolished, military power was concentrated in the capital, and national policy turned from holding the land to holding the frontier, out of which the frontier arrangements and the peacetime pattern of the following centuries grew.
result: 結果是：吳越、漳泉納土之後，江淮、荊湖、兩川、嶺南盡歸中央直屬，太平興國四年（979）十一月太原城破、北漢主降，河北、山西大部入宋，宋朝取得除燕雲十六州與河西走廊以外大部分舊唐北方疆域，統一局面確立。統一並不等於太平：同年高梁河之戰宋太宗親征大敗，僅以身免，遼軍隨即反守為攻；雍熙三年（986）再以三路北伐，中路曹彬敗於幽州城下，東路無功而還，西路潘美、楊業敗於朔州與陳家谷、君子館，楊業死於陳家谷口，遼勢大張，宋人自此放棄主動收復燕雲，改以河防、堡寨與榷場周旋，直至澶淵之盟以歲幣換取長期和平。戰役留下的另一份遺產在制度上：北宋以禁軍為正規軍主力，藩鎮式地方軍被徹底取消，其後兩宋再未出現割據一方的獨立軍鎮，統一格局維持到1127年靖康之難；而削藩與集兵同時造成冗兵、缺馬與文官掣肘之弊，北伐屢敗即為其代價。
resultEn: The result was this: after Wuyue and Zhangquan handed over their territories, the Jianghuai, Jinghu, Shu and Lingnan came fully under the central government; in the eleventh month of the fourth year of Taiping Xingguo (979) Taiyuan fell and the ruler of Northern Han surrendered, and the greater part of Hebei and Shanxi entered the Song, which gained most of the old Tang's northern territory except for the Sixteen Prefectures and the Hexi corridor, and the unified order was established. Unification was not peace: in the same year the emperor's own army was destroyed at Gaolianghe and he escaped with nothing but his life, and the Liao turned from defence to attack; in the third year of Yongxi (986) a three-column northern expedition was launched again, Cao Bin being beaten before Youzhou in the middle route, the eastern column returning with nothing, and Pan Mei and Yang Ye beaten in the western route at Shuozhou, Chenjiagu and Junziguan, Yang Ye dying at Chenjiagu, after which the Liao grew strong and the Song gave up any attempt to recover You and Yun by force of arms, turning instead to the river defences, blockhouses and border trade until the Chanyuan treaty bought long years of peace with annual payments. The other legacy of the campaign was institutional: the Northern Song made the imperial guard the main regular army and abolished the circuit-style local armies altogether, and neither the Northern nor the Southern Song ever again had an independent regional army holding sway over a corner of the realm, so that the unified order held until the Jingkang disaster of 1127. The same concentration of arms and reduction of the circuits, however, produced redundant troops, a shortage of horses and the fettering of the generals by civil officials, and the repeated failure of the northern campaigns was the price of that arrangement.
